# What every repository can do for you

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-capabilities.mjs from the registry in state/fleet.yaml. Do not edit by hand: change the registry. -->

Read this before you build or decide anything (Krish, 2026-11-24: "every single repo must be able to understand what other repos (capabilities) exist around it so collaboration is proactive at all times"). When your work matches a row's **When**, call that repository through its **How to call** instead of doing its job yourself. A call goes through that repository's own walls and widens nothing you may post, send or spend. The routes are as recorded in the registry on 2026-11-24 or later; a route that fails is a finding, so open an `auditor-fix` issue in your own repository naming it, and the internal auditor corrects the registry. Ventures are listed here as neighbours, not in priority order: read the order live from Control Center's PORTFOLIO.md.

## Doctrine

| Repository | What it can do for you | How to call it | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| ai-harness | Rules, skills and the council for every repository; renders the canon block and the neighbours table. | A pull request here, merged through the judge panel; read any skill with Control Center get_skill. | A rule, skill or contract should change, a correction keeps repeating, or a decision needs the council. |

## The hub

| Repository | What it can do for you | How to call it | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| control-center | Gets a decision in front of Krish, reads any venture's state and number, and runs the humour, divergent and research routes. | The engine protocol on your engine's bearer, or the Control Center connector tools (get_venture_state, get_skill, divergent_*, report_to_taste_engine, record_harness_observation). | Anything needs Krish's yes, a live number, another venture's state, or a paid model route under a cap. |

## The keeper of the map

| Repository | What it can do for you | How to call it | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| internal-auditor | Fixes code through its fix queue, merges your green pull requests, and routes work to the specialist that should do it. | Open an issue labelled auditor-fix in your own repository; the fix queue takes it. ## Specialists

| Repository | What it can do for you | How to call it | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| strategist | Turns a stalled number or an idea into plays and one-week tests, tested against the Ikigai's decision rules. | It reads every North Star weekly and any U5 within 24 hours; put a decision for the board to Control Center as an engine proposal behind the strategy wall. | A number is at U4 or U5, growth and product disagree, or an idea needs a test rather than a plan. |
| divergence-engine | Scores a draft or a plan for sameness for free, and maps or challenges an angle (paid, capped). | Control Center /api/divergent/<caller>, or the connector tools divergent_score and divergent_record (free) and divergent_run (paid, capped), in your own namespace. Its package and the canon's Divergence rule still call it divergent-thinker; it is the same repository until the rename lands. | The canon's Divergence rule says when. |
| humour-engine | Makes copy funny the way Krish means it, and checks a joke against the definition. | Control Center /api/humour/<caller> or the engine route /api/growth/engines/<slug>/humour, or the pinned package. | Public copy should land with humour, or a line needs a humour check before it goes out. |
| AEO-Engine | Tells a venture whether AI assistants cite it first for its buyers' questions, and which pages to win. | POST /api/growth/engines/<slug>/answers with your product's buyer questions; read your standing in your directive's ai_answers. | You need to know how AI assistants answer your buyers, or which cited pages are worth winning. |
| filearchives | Follows every Drive and dev folder by id, and protects the Ikigai and its doctrine from being moved, renamed or changed without his ruling. | Report a folder change with its tools/report_folder_change.ps1; its protected files are in policy/protected-files.json. | You create, move, rename or remove a folder in Krish's Drive or dev folders, or touch a protected file. |
| software-qa | A QA pass on code and UI that a fix needs before it merges. | An issue in its repository, or the auditor's routing, once its own route is read and recorded here. | A fix touches code or UI that needs a QA pass beyond the repository's own checks. |
